title: Wizard Rules Schema
description: Schema for defining the step-by-step logic, conditions, and effects of a form wizard.

form_id.description: The unique identifier of the form this ruleset applies to.

initial_step.description: The ID of the first step to display to the user.

steps.description: A dictionary of all steps in the wizard, keyed by their unique step ID.

id.description: The unique identifier for this step. Must match the key in the 'steps' object.

title.description: The display title for this step in the UI.

description.description: An optional description or help text for this step.

fields.description: The list of JSON schema field paths (e.g., 'applicant_information.applicant_personal_details.name' or 'household_members[0].personal_details.first_name') that should be collected on this step. Supports array indexing with [n] syntax.

effects.description: Side effects to apply when this step is reached or completed (e.g., requiring a document).

transitions.description: The logic to determine which step comes next. Evaluated in order; the first transition with a 'condition' that evaluates to truthy (or the first transition without a 'condition') is chosen.

steps.description: Ordered list of step IDs that belong to this section.

condition.description: A JSONata expression evaluated against the form data. Supports comparisons (=, !=, <, >, <=, >=), logical operators (and, or, not), membership (in), existence ($exists), and array indexing with [n] syntax. If it evaluates to truthy, this transition is taken. If omitted, this transition is taken unconditionally.

next_step.description: The ID of the next step to navigate to. Use 'END' to denote the end of the wizard.

type.description: The type of side effect to trigger.

target.description: The target of the effect (e.g., the name of the document to require, or the field path to set).

condition.description: An optional JSONata expression. The effect is only applied if this evaluates to truthy against the form data.
